title: Finite gluing across completion with both prescribed restrictions
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], U its punctured spectrum [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], q:Y→U finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Let C be its maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], c:Spec C→Spec A and W=c⁻¹(U). Given a finite s:E→Spec C and an isomorphism Y×_U W≅s⁻¹(W) over W [def-pc-fibre-product], there exists a finite r:F→Spec A with isomorphisms Y≅r⁻¹(U) over U and F×_Spec(A) Spec C≅E over Spec C.

source.place: Tag 0BLH; More on Algebra, Proposition 15.91.16 and Remark 15.91.20

proof.text: Unpack the supplied overlap isomorphism into CompletionGluingData. Construct the actual ring B=Γ(Y)×_{Γ(P)}Γ(E), its A-algebra map, and F=Spec B using def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections. The projection maps give the punctured and completed comparison maps with proved base equations.

Use the two comparison-isomorphism statements on the fixed construction. Take asIso of the punctured map, and the inverse of asIso of the completed map. The proved base equations, together with the inverse-hom identity, give precisely the morphism equalities in the conclusion.

The completed pullback projection is finite because it is the composite of the inverse completed comparison with the prescribed finite s. Mathlib AdicCompletion.flat_of_isNoetherian and the completion local-hom instance give a flat local completion map; Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom gives faithful flatness. flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff gives a flat surjective scheme map, which is quasi-compact because it is a map of affine schemes. Apply the existing finiteness fpqc descent declaration to conclude IsFinite r.

Return the explicit F, r, the descended finiteness proof, and both comparison isomorphisms. The construction includes the case U is empty; its matching ring then reduces to Γ(E), rather than assuming a zero completed model.

theorem exists_finite_model_of_completed_model
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite q]
    (E : Scheme.{u}) (s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))) [IsFinite s]
    (hext :
      let c := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))
      let W := c ⁻¹ᵁ U
      ∃ e : pullback q (c ∣_ U) ≅ (s ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme,
        e.hom ≫ s ∣_ W = pullback.snd q (c ∣_ U)) :
    ∃ (F : Scheme.{u}) (r : F ⟶ Spec (.of A)), IsFinite r ∧
      (∃ e : Y ≅ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, e.hom ≫ r ∣_ U = q) ∧
      ∃ e : pullback r (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))) ≅ E,
        e.hom ≫ s = pullback.snd r (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))))
